title: What "Iron Sharpens Iron" Actually Costs a Godly Man
caption:
Proverbs 27:17 gets quoted like a compliment. As iron sharpens iron, so a man sharpens his brother.

Nobody mentions the friction. Real accountability isn't a group chat where everyone says they're fine. It's a brother who asks the specific question, shows up on the week you don't want him to, and won't let you quietly slide once he knows.

Confess your sins to one another, that you may be healed (James 5:16). The healing comes after the honesty, never instead of it.
